name: Spicy Ham Fried Rice with Broccoli, Cabbage & Ginger

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with stir-fry sauce, water, hoisin sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and garlic powder. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 cup stir-fry sauce
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup hoisin sauce
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
When the rice is done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is resting, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is soft, add ham, cabbage, and sauce to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is wilted and warmed through, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

instructions.primary_message: Add rice to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
